cues.en: year.

cues.zh: 因为我们的城市设计只考虑了开车。
cues.en: Because we’ve designed our cities only for driving.

cues.zh: 而当城市规划者试图让街道更安全时，批评者就拿家庭
cues.en: And when urban planners try to make the streets safer, their critics use excuses like families,

cues.zh: 和运货当借口，反对修建安全的基础设施。
cues.en: and hauling cargo as reasons not to build safe infrastructure.

cues.zh: 因为那些无知的人根本想象不到，自行车道除了
cues.en: Because those ignorant people can’t imagine a bicycle path being used by anyone except

cues.zh: 二三十岁、体格健壮的男性之外，还有谁会去用。
cues.en: physically fit men in their 20s or 30s.

cues.zh: 但当你真正建起安全的基础设施，你得到的就是这样的景象。
cues.en: But when you actually build safe infrastructure, you get stuff like this.

cues.zh: 每个人都能因此受益。
cues.en: And everybody is better off for it.

cues.zh: 我们需要为箱式货运自行车（bakfiets）及其他货运自行车来规划城市。
cues.en: We need to design our cities for bakfietsen and other kinds of cargo bikes.

cues.zh: 不需要人人每次出行都用它们，但它们必须得是
cues.en: They don’t need to be used by every person, for every trip, but they do need to be an

cues.zh: 一种选择。
cues.en: option.

cues.zh: 无论是出于环保考量，
cues.en: For environmental reasons.

cues.zh: 出于经济原因，
cues.en: For financial reasons.

cues.zh: 还是单纯因为它们效率更高。
cues.en: Or even just because they’re more efficient.

cues.zh: 这意味着自行车道必须通达人们要去的每一个地方，而且必须设计得
cues.en: That means bike paths need to be built everywhere people need to go, and they need to be designed

cues.zh: 更宽敞。
cues.en: wider.

cues.zh: 自行车停车位也必须兼顾停放这类自行车的空间。
cues.en: And bike parking needs to be designed to fit these kinds of bicycles, too.

cues.zh: 包括路边的泊位，就像哥本哈根这样。
cues.en: Including spots on the street, like here in Copenhagen.

cues.zh: 或者像巴黎这里一样。
cues.en: Or here in Paris.

cues.zh: 箱式货运自行车的浪潮即将到来。
cues.en: The bakfiets revolution is coming.

cues.zh: 而那些最成功的城市，必将是早已为此做好准备的城市。
cues.en: And the most successful cities will be the ones that are prepared for it.
